tool: cfo.ai (MCP https://api.cfo.ai/mcp), built from the operator's inputs; numbers labelled MEASURED or ASSUMPTION in cfo.ai

runway.Upside: beyond 24 months (cash low point ~$139.6k in month 11; ~$697.9k at month 24)

cashflowPositiveMonth.Base: never sustained within 24 months (net cash flow positive only in months 3-6, before the month-7 founder salary and engineer)
cashflowPositiveMonth.Downside: never sustained within 24 months (net cash flow positive only in months 3-6)
cashflowPositiveMonth.Upside: plan month 12 (Sep 2027), positive every month from then to month 24

assumptions.pricing: Team $499/month incl. 200 replayed tasks; overage $0.50/task; revenue per paying team $549/month

issues: inspect_skills (build-model) was denied permission. Table and formula calls were checked against inspect_documentation plus a dry_run instead.
Main Scenario's calendar range_end was extended from 2027-12-31 to 2028-12-31 to hold 24 months. Plan month 1 = Oct 2026, the first forecast month after last close (2026-09-30).

Main Scenario holds the Base inputs. 'Base' inherits them with no overrides. 'Downside' overrides starting teams (2) and growth (5%). 'Upside' overrides starting teams (8), growth (18%) and the model cost per replay formula (points to DeepSeek Flash, $0.036).
Paying teams are compounded and not rounded, so they can be fractional.
ASSUMPTION added: the 5 design partners use the free observational tier ($0 model calls), so they add no replay cost.

Every scenario has positive net cash flow in plan months 3-6, before the founder salary and the first engineer start in month 7. cashflowPositiveMonth reports the month from which cash flow stays positive through month 24.
Runway = full months before the first month with cash < 0.

Hire vs scale: option A's surviving changes per month were not measured, so the cell is deliberately empty. Option B's $6.75/month and 75 changes/month come from book.json's scenario block, and its basis cell is labelled MEASURED cost per session × ASSUMED 50 sessions/week.
Starting cash of $150,000 is an ASSUMPTION; the operator has to confirm it.
updateArgsExample uses placeholder numbers to show the shape only. It has not been executed.
Read-only public share links were created afterwards for the plan and the book pages (see shareUrls); they open logged-out.
